title: E3 ubiquitin ligases: a vital component of proteostasis impaired in hereditary neuropathies
title_zh: E3泛素连接酶：遗传性神经病中受损蛋白稳态的关键组成部分
abstract: Abstract Protein homeostasis is essential for the maintenance of peripheral axons and depends on co-ordinated protein synthesis, folding, ubiquitination and directing protein fate across multiple protein quality-control pathways. E3 ubiquitin ligases are central to this network by conferring substrate specificity and enabling precise spatiotemporal regulation of protein homeostasis. Increasing genetic and functional evidence implicates the disruption of E3 ligase function in inherited peripheral neuropathies, providing a mechanistic link between impaired proteostasis and progressive axonal degeneration. Here, we examine inherited peripheral neuropathies associated with dysfunction of Tripartite Motif-Containing Protein 2 (TRIM2), Leucine Rich Repeat and Sterile Alpha Motif Containing 1 (LRSAM1), Ubiquitin Protein Ligase E3C (UBE3C) and the Cullin-Ring 3 (CUL3) substrate adapter, Gigaxonin (GAN). Although these proteins differ in structure, substrates and disease mechanisms, their dysfunction converges on disruption of proteasomal degradation, autophagy and cytoskeletal homeostasis. By integrating these genetically distinct neuropathies within a common mechanistic framework, we propose this positions E3 ubiquitin ligases as selective regulators of multiple protein quality-control pathways and highlights the specific vulnerability of long peripheral axons to the disruption of ubiquitin-mediated proteostasis.
abstract_zh: 蛋白稳态对于外周轴突的维持至关重要，依赖于蛋白质合成、折叠、泛素化以及在多条蛋白质量控制通路中精准调控蛋白命运的协同作用。E3泛素连接酶通过赋予底物特异性并实现空间-时间精确调控，处于这一网络的核心。越来越多的遗传和功能证据表明，E3连接酶功能的紊乱与遗传性外周神经病相关，为受损蛋白稳态与进行性轴突退化之间提供了机制性联系。本文考察了与三聚体基序蛋白2（TRIM2）、富含亮氨酸重复和无菌α基序蛋白1（LRSAM1）、泛素蛋白连接酶E3C（UBE3C）以及Cullin-Ring 3（CUL3）底物适配器Gigaxonin（GAN）功能障碍相关的遗传性外周神经病。尽管这些蛋白在结构、底物和疾病机制上各不相同，但其功能障碍最终导致蛋白酶体降解、自噬和细胞骨架稳态的破坏。通过将这些遗传上不同的神经病整合到一个共同的机制框架中，我们提出E3泛素连接酶是多条蛋白质量控制通路的选择性调节因子，并强调了长外周轴突对泛素介导蛋白稳态破坏的特殊脆弱性。
